name: JG_FSCL_TAX_LINES_ALL
description: This table stores tax lines of the inbound fiscal document after validation.

columns.name: TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for a particular tax line in a table.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_ID
columns.description: Tax identifier for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAXABLE_AMT
columns.description: Amount in entered currency on which the tax rate is applied to calculate the tax amount.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code specified for a tax status for an effective time period, expressed as a percentage or a value per unit quantity.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the rate specified for a tax status for an effective time period.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Rate specified for a tax status for an effective time period. A tax rate can be expressed as a percentage or a value per unit quantity.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Exact or specified amount or measure.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure code for quantity based rates.

columns.name: TAX_AMT
columns.description: Tax amount associated with the tax distribution.

columns.name: EXEMPT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for a tax exemption.

columns.name: VALUE_ADDED_MARGIN_PERC
columns.description: Value added margin percentage for the tax.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_REDUCTION_PERC
columns.description: Percentage by which taxable amount should be reduced for tax calculation.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_PERC_PAYER_OPR
columns.description: Taxable basis percentage taxpayer operation.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for a geographic area where a tax is levied by a specific tax authority.

columns.name: SERVICE_ITEM_CODE
columns.description: Item bought or sold in the associated transaction, which may be a tangible item or an intangible item such as a service.

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code for a tax reporting type that identifies specific units of information, such as dates or text comments, to associate with specific tax usage.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique code provided by the tax authority for a compactly settled area as distinguished from the surrounding rural territory.

columns.name: TAXABLE_AMT_DETERM_CODE
columns.description: Code used for tax reporting purposes that represents the type of taxable basis amount determination.

columns.name: TAX_SITUATION_CODE
columns.description: Code used for tax reporting purposes that represents the tax situation.

columns.name: MAIN_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier of the transaction that was divided into multiple lines.

columns.name: TAX_CREDIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tax credit amount informed by city tax authority. In some cases, this tax credit amount can be deducted by tax payer from other city taxes.

columns.name: CAL_TAX_AMT
columns.description: System calculated tax amount in transaction currency.

columns.name: USER_ENTERED_TAX_AMT
columns.description: User entered tax amount in transaction currency if tax calculation is not correct.

columns.name: TAX_LINE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the source of tax line. Valid values are Manually Created, Imported or System Generated.

columns.name: TAX_HOLD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates reason for hold on the tax line. Possible values are 1 for tax variance hold, 2 for tax amount range hold and 3 for both.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the first party organization of the transaction.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_ID
columns.description: Identifier of tax regime associated with the tax line.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of tax status associated with the tax line.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of tax jurisdiction associated with the tax line.

columns.name: TAX_ONLY_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the transaction is only for tax. Select Y if the line is only for tax and is not related to other item lines of the transaction.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Tax line identifier from adjusted document.

columns.name: CAL_TAX_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: System calculated tax amount in tax currency. This is same as the tax amount in tax currency if there is no user override.

columns.name: TAX_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: Amount associated with tax line in tax currency.

columns.name: USER_ENTERED_TAX_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: User entered tax amount in tax currency if tax calculation is not correct.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_STATUS_ID
columns.description: Value of tax status identifier present prior to user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Value of tax status code present prior to user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Value of tax rate identifier present prior to user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Value of tax rate code present prior to user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Value of tax rate present prior to user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Value of tax jurisdiction identifier present prior to user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Value of tax jurisdiction code present prior to user override.

columns.name: ORIG_TAX_AMT_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Inclusive tax amount calculated by the application, prior to user updates.

columns.name: ORIG_SELF_ASSESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Self-assessed tax amount calculated by the application, prior to user updates.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DOC_UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Identifies the reference document unit price.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DOC_LINE_AMT
columns.description: Identifies the reference document line amount.

columns.name: SELF_ASSESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the tax line is self-assessed. Select Y if the tax line is self-assessed by the first party organization.

columns.name: REPORTING_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this tax line is created for reporting only. Valid vaules: Y and N.
